title: Parish and Cipher
author: Theo Zhou
blurb: Silas Halloran, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
